title: Remote Security Assessment
headline: Review security settings on an enrolled device and get prioritized next steps.
description: A guided remote review of updates, accounts, browsers, backups, and device settings for Central Florida Remote Support Plan clients.
metaTitle: Remote Security Assessment for Central Florida Plan Clients
metaDescription: Review updates, accounts, browsers, backups, and device settings remotely, then receive prioritized security steps for enrolled devices.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Missing updates, weak account recovery, and unnecessary browser extensions can create avoidable risk.
Security software cannot protect an account that uses a reused password or an unsafe recovery method.
A backup should be checked regularly so you know it can restore the files that matter.

sections.heading: What We Review
paragraph: We review the security controls that matter most for the selected enrolled devices and accounts.
items: Account passwords, multi-factor authentication, and recovery methods
A written summary with prioritized next steps

sections.heading: What to Expect
paragraph: This service requires an active Remote Support Plan and an enrolled device.
We review the agreed areas during a secure remote session and explain what we are checking.
After the session, you receive a practical summary that separates urgent work from later improvements.

faq.question: Do I need the Remote Support Plan for this service?
faq.answer: Yes. Remote Security Assessments are available only for devices enrolled in an active Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: What do you review during the assessment?
faq.answer: The scope can include updates, installed software, account protection, browser settings, security software, device encryption, and backups.

faq.question: Will I receive clear next steps?
faq.answer: Yes. You receive a written summary with prioritized actions so you know what to address first.
